kind: Mock DOM/Lamgl host checks, not actual browser/GPU execution

rows.name: Template initialization chooses 512 × 384 Mandelbulb and both sources exist
The actual Lamgl canvas is appended into the viewport
Missing GPU timer disables comparison and GFLOP/s without disabling rendering
Each displayed tensor is freed after display and compile probes are freed
Mandelbrot/Mandelbulb switching loads matching source and kernel
Pointer drag changes the Mandelbulb camera and release stops dragging
Mandelbrot wheel zoom keeps the pointed coordinate fixed
Apply uses normalized edited source and handwritten mode ignores edits
Rejected apply is transactional: current program and selected mode stay coherent
A failed edit does not poison the saved source when switching away and back
Driver shader compilation failure also preserves the active program
Source/report/PNG actions trigger downloads and textarea accepts Tab
CPU check task restores controls and timer-disabled controls remain disabled
Context loss cancels animation and displays recovery instruction
GPU timer starts/ends query, converts nanoseconds, and deletes completed query
An incomplete timer query remains pending until available
Disjoint GPU samples are discarded, never interpreted as throughput
Queries time out after 15 seconds and are deleted
Nonpositive GPU elapsed values are rejected
Another active GPU query cannot be silently nested
Clearing an active timer ends and deletes it
Asynchronous GPU measurement waits for result rather than timing submission
Missing timer extension refuses fake submission-time GFLOP/s
Benchmark iteration bounds and nominal operation structure remain fixed
Fractal timing action completes rotated samples and publishes stack/manual ratio
Arithmetic benchmark action uses GPU milliseconds and explicit nominal work
Cancellation between submissions restores controls without another workload
GPU correctness button invokes both primitive and fractal check suites
